mapper.select: SELECT a.ast03_cf_info_id AS cfInfoId, a.ast03_ast_class_tree_id AS astClassTreeId, a.ast03_cf_cd AS cfCode, a.ast03_cf_nm AS cfName, a.ast03_tr_cd AS trCode, t.ast05_tr_nm AS trName, a.ast03_start_ym AS startYm, a.ast03_close_ym AS closeYm, a.ast03_cycle AS cycle, a.ast03_date_cd AS dateCode, f_cdnm('DateCode', a.ast03_date_cd, c.ast01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS dateName, a.ast03_holiday_settle_cd AS holidaySettleCode, f_cdnm('HolidaySettleCode', a.ast03_holiday_settle_cd, c.ast01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS holidaySettleName, a.ast03_amt AS amt, a.ast03_note AS note, a.ast03_round AS round, COALESCE(a.ast03_icam_yn, 'false') AS icamYn, a.ast03_cont_amt AS contAmt, a.ast03_tax AS tax, a.ast03_corp_id AS corpId, f_get_corp_nm(a.ast03_corp_id) AS corpName FROM ast03_cf_info a INNER JOIN ast01_class_tree c ON c.ast01_class_tree_id = a.ast03_ast_class_tree_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ast05_tr_code t ON (t.ast05_company_id = c.ast01_company_id AND t.ast05_tr_cd = a.ast03_tr_cd) WHERE a.ast03_ast_class_tree_id = #{astClassTreeId} ORDER BY a.ast03_cf_cd

SELECT ast04_cf_id AS cfId, ast04_cf_info_id AS cfInfoId, ast04_seq AS seq, ast04_date AS date, ast04_settle_date AS settleDate, ast04_settle_amt AS settleAmt, ast04_note AS note, ast04_cont_amt AS contAmt, ast04_tax AS tax FROM ast04_cf WHERE ast04_cf_info_id = #{cfInfoId} ORDER BY ast04_date
mapper.update: UPDATE ast03_cf_info SET ast03_cf_cd = #{req.cfCode}, ast03_cf_nm = #{req.cfName}, ast03_tr_cd = #{req.trCode}, ast03_corp_id = #{req.corpId}, ast03_icam_yn = COALESCE(#{req.icamYn}, 'false'), ast03_note = #{req.note} WHERE ast03_cf_info_id = #{req.cfInfoId}

UPDATE ast04_cf SET ast04_seq = #{req.seq}, ast04_date = #{req.date}, ast04_settle_date = #{req.settleDate}, ast04_settle_amt = #{req.settleAmt}, ast04_cont_amt = #{req.contAmt}, ast04_tax = #{req.tax}, ast04_note = #{req.note} WHERE ast04_cf_id = #{req.cfId}

UPDATE ast03_cf_info SET ast03_date_cd = #{req.dateCode}, ast03_holiday_settle_cd = #{req.holidaySettleCode}, ast03_start_ym = #{req.startYm}, ast03_close_ym = #{req.closeYm}, ast03_amt = #{req.amt}, ast03_cont_amt = #{req.contAmt}, ast03_tax = #{req.tax}, ast03_cycle = #{req.cycle}, ast03_round = #{req.round} WHERE ast03_cf_info_id = #{req.cfInfoId}
